front.title: Apple's New CEO John Ternus Is Making Product Design a 'Major Priority'
front.tldr: Since becoming Apple's chief executive last month, John Ternus has made product design a core priority, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports, taking a hands-on role with the design studio.

front.title: MacBook Pro With OLED Display Rumored to Be 'Significantly Lighter'
front.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple's new OLED MacBook Pro models will be significantly lighter than today's, thanks to a reengineered interior.

front.title: Patriots Upset Previously Unbeaten Bills 29-26, Pulling Back to .500
front.tldr: New England beat the previously unbeaten Buffalo Bills 29-26 in Sunday's close finish, pulling the Patriots back to a .500 record.

stories.title: Apple Event Reportedly Planned for October 13
stories.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple plans to unveil a new smart home hub, a HomePod mini and an Apple TV 4K at an event on 13 October.

stories.title: Apple Hiring 'iCup' Specialist
stories.tldr: Apple has posted a job listing for an 'iCup Supply Specialist', responsible for keeping staff supplied with freshly brewed coffee in their break rooms.

stories.title: iPhone Duo Shows What the Future of Smartphones Could Look Like
stories.tldr: Apple's iPhone Duo design puts every major navigation element within reach of your thumb, reviving a one-handed approach to smartphone interfaces.

stories.title: Avengers: Endgame Returns to No. 1 on the All-Time Global Box Office Chart, Surpassing Avatar
stories.tldr: Marvel's 2019 release has returned to theatres and reclaimed the top spot on the all-time global box office chart from Avatar, ahead of this year's Doomsday.

stories.title: Pedro Pascal's 'Behemoth!' Role Is the Oscar Case He and Latinos Have Been Waiting For
stories.tldr: Pedro Pascal stars in Tony Gilroy's 'Behemoth!', his first feature as director since 'The Bourne Legacy', which world-premiered at Alice Tully Hall.

stories.title: Tom Cruise's 'Digger' Buried at Box Office With $8M as 'Verity' Wins Weekend
stories.tldr: Alejandro G. Iñárritu's pricey satire 'Digger', starring Tom Cruise, opened to just $8 million, a big financial loss for Warner Bros.

stories.title: J. Todd Anderson, 'The Nice Guys' Storyboard Artist and Longtime Coen Brothers Collaborator, Dies at 67
stories.tldr: J. Todd Anderson, the storyboard artist behind 'The Nice Guys' and 'Raising Arizona' and a longtime Coen brothers collaborator, has died at 67 after a battle with cancer.

stories.title: Box Office: John Wilson's 'The History of Concrete' From Magnolia Passes $1 Million
stories.tldr: John Wilson's Sundance documentary 'The History of Concrete' has passed $1 million at the box office, the year's highest-grossing platform release among documentaries.

stories.title: Celtics' Charleston Training Camp Notebook: Yoga, an Unlikely Vet and New Coaches
stories.tldr: For the first time in nearly a decade, the Celtics held part of preseason camp away from home, training in Charleston, South Carolina, at The Citadel.

stories.title: Efton Chism Provides Heroics With 'Snag of the Year' to Help Patriots Beat Bills
stories.tldr: Patriots receiver Efton Chism made what teammates called the 'snag of the year', a touchdown catch that proved decisive in New England's win over Buffalo.

stories.title: Mack Hollins Injury: Patriots Receiver Unable to Finish Bills Game
stories.tldr: New England's leading receiver, Mack Hollins, was unable to finish Sunday's win over the Bills with a calf injury, though the Patriots held on to win.

stories.title: Verstappen Takes First Win of 2026 in Malaysia After Power Unit Faults Delay Start
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen claimed his first Formula 1 win of the season at the chaotic Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, after rain and technical trouble delayed the start.

stories.title: Russell 'Beyond Disappointment' as Wolff 'Massively Annoyed' by Engine Failure
stories.tldr: A late engine failure ended George Russell's podium chance and dealt a blow to his title hopes, with Mercedes boss Toto Wolff calling himself 'massively annoyed'.

finally.title: Museum Vonk Is 'a Testing Ground for Affordable Bio-Based Construction'
finally.tldr: Dutch studio Studio Marco Vermeulen has completed Museum Vonk in Eindhoven, a wedge-shaped history museum with hempcrete facades coloured by pigmented lime plaster.
